speaker: josias_thwaite
text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the fellowship of the Holy Ghost, be with us all evermore.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Amen. Two glasses, and the last grain gone. Out into the porch before the north aisle is on our heels.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: He goes in at his own gate, Mistress, and nobody walks before him.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: A man is not Lord Mayor forever. Keep your cloak shut.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The house is dark tomorrow. I am going west. Twelve pence at the gate, and a place behind other men.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: A widow of two-and-fifty has seen horses run at a rail. I am not going to Paul's, and I am not going to Whitehall.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: May I see the fire tomorrow, if there is a fire at the corner?

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: We shall see how the broth stands. I promise nothing before the pot is skimmed.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: Norwich. Yes. In Norwich also they ring the bells on the seventeenth.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Norwich is the word, Gillis, and you do well to remember it in this porch.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The fifty leaves went to Master Garnish on Wednesday. This afternoon the table has a letter, and nothing else.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then the ceiling may have a quiet day. Write it while the sun is in the pane.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The loaf this morning wanted a full thumb of the notch.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: A thumb, and a penny. I know what the notch says.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: At the corner it was no heavier. I did not argue with the stall.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A penny. I am not arguing with the board.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: My ink is twopence the horn, if the letter wants it. Daylight costs you nothing.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will write after dinner. The sheet can wait for the carrier. It does not go today.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Is tomorrow a holiday from the work as well?

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: The afternoon, when the guns go. I have said Norwich. I will say no other town.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Good. Dinner is at twelve. Alse, the salt-fish when your shoes are off.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Twelve. I will be in. The letter is for home, and it is not a quarrel I mean to win.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then do not win it. Master Thwaite is out with his book. We are done in the yard.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: God keep this house.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: And this parish. Come, both of you.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am coming.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I have the cloak.
